2608.11738.title: Advancing MLLM-based UAV Image Understanding and Reasoning: A Benchmark and a Training-Free Multi-Agent System
2608.11738.paper_summary: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning is essential for aerial intelligence yet poses distinct challenges arising from extreme scale variation, arbitrary camera orientations, and high object density. Despite growing interest, existing evaluations remain fragmented across individual datasets and narrow tasks, leaving a critical gap in unified assessment of UAV understanding and reasoning capabilities. To fill this gap, we construct UAVQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,500 human-annotated QA pairs drawn from 13 public UAV datasets, covering 6 capability dimensions and 16 tasks in both multiple-choice and visual grounding formats. Systematic evaluation of a broad range of open-source and closed-source MLLMs as well as agent-based systems on UAVQA-Bench identifies three key failure modes: domain-toolset mismatch, unchecked error propagation, and static reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose UAV-MAS, a training-free multi-agent system for MLLM-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning, comprising a Domain-Specific Perception Engine (DSPE) that routes queries to task-appropriate visual tools, a Context-Aware Iterative Refinement module (CAIR) that validates intermediate reasoning to curb error accumulation, and a Difficulty-Aware Adaptive Search mechanism (DAAS) that adjusts search depth to question difficulty. UAV-MAS with a 32B open-source MLLM achieves 77.0% overall accuracy on UAVQA-Bench, surpassing Gemini 3 Pro by 4.0\%, while the 8B variant improves 8.7\% over its base model.
2608.11738.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）基於無人機的空中影像理解與推理對於空中情報至關重要，但由於極端的尺度變化、任意的相機方向和高物體密度，這也帶來了獨特的挑戰。儘管興趣日益增加，現有的評估仍然分散在各個單獨數據集和狹窄任務中，留下了對無人機理解和推理能力的統一評估的關鍵空白。為填補這一空白，我們構建了UAVQA-Bench，這是一個包含1,500個人類標註的問答對的基準，這些問答對來自13個公共無人機數據集，涵蓋了6個能力維度和16個任務，形式包括多選題和視覺定位格式。對於UAVQA-Bench上廣泛的開源和閉源MLLM以及基於代理的系統的系統評估，確定了三個主要的失敗模式：領域工具集不匹配、未檢查的錯誤傳播和靜態推理。受到這些發現的啟發，我們提出了UAV-MAS，這是一個無需訓練的多代理系統，用於基於MLLM的無人機空中影像理解和推理，包含一個領域特定感知引擎（DSPE），該引擎將查詢路由到任務適當的視覺工具、一個上下文感知的迭代精煉模塊（CAIR），該模塊驗證中間推理以抑制錯誤累積，以及一個難度感知自適應搜索機制（DAAS），該機制根據問題難度調整搜索深度。使用32B開源MLLM的UAV-MAS在UAVQA-Bench上達到了77.0%的整體準確率，超過了Gemini 3 Pro 4.0%，而8B變體則比其基礎模型提高了8.7%。
